name: Department of Jyotisha, Government Sanskrit College, Thiruvananthapuram
tagline: Kerala's government college department for traditional jyotiṣa study and workshops
summary: A recognised academic department within Government Sanskrit College (Palayam) that teaches Sanskrit jyotiṣa (astronomy/astrology), runs seminars and workshops, and hosts researchers and visiting…
description: The Department of Jyotisha at Government Sanskrit College, Palayam (Thiruvananthapuram) is the college unit that teaches classical jyotiṣa as part of the University of Kerala–affiliated Sanskrit curriculum. It covers traditional Kerala methods of astronomy, muhurta, pañchāṅga and related Sanskrit literature.

The department supports academic study (BA Sanskrit Jyotisha and related courses), runs webinars, national seminars and multi‑day workshops, and invites scholars from Kerala and other states. Its activities include paper presentations, practical sessions on pañchāṅga/ganita and sessions linking jyotiṣa with Sanskrit texts.

Researchers, students of classical astronomy and visiting event attendees use the department as a formal, government-run centre for Kerala-style jyotiṣa study. The college is on the University/Palayam campus in central Thiruvananthapuram, making it convenient for scholars visiting the capital.
highlights: BA (Sanskrit Jyotisha) teaching under University of Kerala
Regular webinars, seminars and multi‑day workshops on Kerala jyotiṣa traditions
Faculty and guest scholars from Kerala and other Indian universities
Located in Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram — close to the University campus and state institutions
Facilities include an astronomy lab listed on the college site

sections.heading: Background
body: Government Sanskrit College, Thiruvananthapuram (Palayam) is a long‑established Sanskrit institution affiliated to the University of Kerala. The college organogram and prospectus show an academic Department of Jyotisha (Sanskrit Jyotisha) inside the college's Oriental Studies faculty.
Jyotisha at the college follows the classical syllabus (astronomy/astrology, pañchāṅga, muhurta, Ganita and related Sanskrit texts) and forms part of BA/UG offerings listed for the college.

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: Attend a departmental seminar or public lecture when the college schedules one — the department regularly lists webinars, national seminars and workshops on its Programs page and in college reports.

For researchers: consult departmental faculty, check forthcoming workshop notices and request access to college lecture notes or reading lists. Departments often host paper‑presentation sessions and invited‑scholar talks that are useful for specialist research.

Event visitors: many workshops include practical demonstrations (pañchāṅga calculations, Kerala jātaka/paddhati sessions, muhurta practice and paper presentations). Verify dates and registration with the college before planning travel.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Location and contact: Government Sanskrit College is in Palayam, Thiruvananthapuram (pin 695034). Use the college contact channels to confirm event dates, registration and whether sessions are open to the public.

Timing and access: departmental events run on campus (seminar hall/auditorium) or online (Zoom/YouTube) depending on the programme. Confirm in advance—details and downloadable notices appear on the college 'Programs' and 'Notifications' pages or in PDF reports.

latest.text: Faculty from the Department of Jyotisha are listed as participants/panelists in the National Research Conference & Kerala Higher Education Expo 2026 schedule.
The college's AQAR (Annual Quality Assurance Report) for 2022–23 is published and lists the Department of Jyotisha as an active academic unit (contact details and departmental listings included).

The department organised an eight‑day workshop titled 'Peculiarities of Kerala Tradition in Jyotisham (Astrology and Astronomy)' held 6–13 December 2023 (multi‑day programme with invited scholars and sessions on pañchāṅga, muhurta and Kerala jātaka method).

visitorInfo.bestTime: Events and seminars run year‑round; check the college 'Programs' page for scheduled workshops and webinar dates.
visitorInfo.howToReach: Palayam (central Thiruvananthapuram). Reach Palayam by city bus or taxi from Thiruvananthapuram Central Railway Station (≈3–4 km) or Trivandrum International Airport (≈7–8 km). Confirm event venue and entry with the college office before you travel.
etiquette: Contact the college office (govtsktcollegetvm@gmail.com / phone listed on the site) to confirm event dates, registration and public access.
Many academic sessions are technical and language‑specific (Sanskrit); bring a local contact or translator if you need Malayalam/English assistance.
For research visits, request faculty contact and any required permissions in advance; departmental schedules and PDF notices are the official source for events.
